links.outcome: LLM ROC performance compared with GRACE and TIMI scores for one-year MACE
links.effect: None of the LLMs outperformed traditional clinical scores; ChatGPT 4o performed below both GRACE and TIMI score.
links.quote: ROC analysis indicated that none of the LLMs outperformed traditional clinical scores, with ChatGPT 4o performing below both GRACE and TIMI score.

links.outcome: Output reproducibility of LLM risk predictions across ten independent runs
links.effect: All models showed substantial output variability across ten independent runs; Grok 3's highest initial accuracy did not persist in average performance over all runs.
links.quote: All models demonstrated significant risk overestimation and substantial output variability across ten independent runs.

screen.reason: The study benchmarked three general-purpose LLMs on patient datasets for predicting one-year MACE in acute coronary syndrome, evaluating accuracy and output variability across runs without testing specific deployment safeguards.
